sourceTitle: The Apology of the Augsburg Confession
description: "The Apology of the Augsburg Confession" by Philipp Melanchthon is a theological defense written during and after the 1530 Diet of Augsburg. Composed as a response to the official Catholic refutation of Lutheran beliefs, this document became the longest text in the Book of Concord.
